redirect.to: The address answered with a redirect to {{location, vendor}}. Enter the address the service is really at: the app doesn't follow redirects, so your credentials never go anywhere else.
redirect.bare: The address answered with a redirect. Enter the address the service is really at: the app doesn't follow redirects, so your credentials never go anywhere else.

status.server-error: {{service}} answered {{status}}. Its own log says why.
status.unexpected: {{service}} answered {{status}}, which it doesn't send for this request. Check the address.

unreachable.host-not-found: Couldn't reach {{service}} at {{address}}: the host name can't be found.
unreachable.refused: Couldn't reach {{service}} at {{address}}: nothing accepted the connection. Check the address and port, and that {{service}} is running.
unreachable.secure-connection: Couldn't reach {{service}} at {{address}}: the secure (HTTPS) connection failed, for example because its certificate isn't trusted.
unreachable.failed: Couldn't reach {{service}} at {{address}}: the connection failed before it answered.

too-large: The answer from {{address}} is far larger than anything {{service}} sends. Check the address.

timeout.connect_one: {{service}} at {{address}} didn't accept the connection within {{count, number}} second. Check the address and port, and that {{service}} is running.
timeout.connect_other: {{service}} at {{address}} didn't accept the connection within {{count, number}} seconds. Check the address and port, and that {{service}} is running.
timeout.answer_one: {{service}} at {{address}} didn't answer within {{count, number}} second.
timeout.answer_other: {{service}} at {{address}} didn't answer within {{count, number}} seconds.
